text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My head hurts...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I must've been out for a while. When did
I—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey, you. You're finally awake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon, a talented runner that
even a rookie trainer like
myself has heard
about, is standing right in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're in a state of shock. You
just regained consciousness,
so I'd advise
you to not overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now, sit in this chair for me. It's time to relax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do as she says and sit on the infirmary
stool.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now... do you know why you're here? Can
you recall?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: By the way, I'm the one who carried you here while you were unconscious. So the question is how—and why—did you lose consciousness?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rack my brain for an answer as dull
throbbing pain courses through
my head. If
I recall, I was walking down the hallway...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hey, heeey, heeeeey! Tachyon, I said
waaait!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why, if it isn't Bakushin O! What's got you
this riled up? It's not like
your beloved
homeroom was burned to a crisp or
anything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You're right, it wasn't burned to a crisp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Then all's well that ends well. See you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Your class representative commands you to stop! There's nothing well about any of this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the classroom is still standing! BUT!
Do you understand how
close we got to
disaster?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: One corner of the classroom had an eensy bit of smoke, right? Is it really something our class representative should get so upset about?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! H-hmmm... When you put it that
way...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You only filled the entire classroom with smoke, so I guess I should let you off this time?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Magnanimity is a virtue, class
representative. You would do well to

remember that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, wait! The teacher even told me eight
times to ignore the
excuses and capture
you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I won't let you escape, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! I knew that wouldn't work!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Stop right there! BAKUSHIN, BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You there—yes, you, the trainer! Don't
let Tachyon through!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Whoa, there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, looks like you remember the events
that transpired.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I certainly do, including the fact that the
girl in front of me is the
culprit who filled
the classroom with smoke.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What a peculiar thing to ask... To further my research. Why else?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Research... Agnes Tachyon's eyes light up as she says the word.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Noting to myself that it's probably best to
not get too involved with
her, I attempt to
stand up—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creak...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (When did she tie me to this chair?!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Might you be the type who gets lost in
their own thoughts? As
someone of the
same breed, I understand your confusion
all too well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Out of the kindness of my heart, here's
some advice—you'd be wise to
guard
yourself better.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After all, you never know when you might
run into a researcher
looking for a spry,
healthy adult male to serve as her test
subject,
right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After all, you never know when you might
run into a researcher
looking for a spry,
healthy adult female to serve as her test
subject,
right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As for me, this windfall is certainly
welcome. Maybe I should pay my
respects
at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, everyone at this academy
already knows me far too well.
Forget
asking for test subjects—everyone runs
away from me on sight.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And yet—HA-HA-HA! Never would I have
imagined that fresh blood
would show up
on my doorstep! What a stroke of luck!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, my guinea pig—ah, apologies, I mean
rookie trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
An adult needn't worry about such trifling
matters.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I have one
special—wait, given your heartiness, I'll

have you drink three of my medicines.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh, the proof is in the
pudding—or should I say, the
medicine?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry... Worst case, both of your
legs will glow green-gold for a
few hours.
A cute side effect, if I say so myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What I really want to see is the human
quadricipital data that I can
collect with
this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's a well-known fact that human and
Umamusume body structures are
almost
entirely identical, but by comparing data
from both, perhaps a
new—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon... Are you up to no good again?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why, if it isn't Cafe! What's the matter?
Perhaps you've finally come
to join my
experiment—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Keep dreaming. I came to tell you that the
teacher's looking for you. I
think... it's
about the upcoming tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up... and go already. Now... Right
now...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, okay... Message received, so don't
glare at me like that! Looks
like the
experiment will have to be put on hold.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: See you around, rookie trainer!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'll... untie you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stammer out my thanks as I count my
lucky stars. I'm saved... At least,
for now.
